What does Otto mean, and how will it help you?

“Otto” is the Italian word for “eight,” which directly connects to “Octave”—a musical and mathematical interval spanning eight notes.

Meet Otto, our new AI agent powered by an advanced, local on-premises, agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.

Unlike standard, single-pass RAG pipelines, Otto operates as a true reasoning agent:

Secure Document Q&A: Otto answers complex questions directly from the secure documents you provide.
Iterative Reasoning: Rather than a simple search, Otto plans steps, selects tools, acts, and observes to uncover the truth.
Private & Transparent: Running entirely on an on-premises local LLM, Otto delivers citation-backed answers while streaming its progress live.
Built to Scale: Tested and verified, Otto can seamlessly scale using an Azure Foundry API key when required.

Tackle your Day with Otto, Your Cute Personal Assistant
